integration.name: Postmark
integration.summary: A transactional-first mail provider. Sending is authorized by a server token, and the From address has to match a confirmed sender signature in the account.

credentials.label: Server Token
credentials.note: The token for the server you send from — Postmark sends it as a header, and it is not the account API token.

config.label: Sender address (From)
config.note: Must correspond to a sender signature you have already confirmed in Postmark.

strengths: A per-server token rather than an account-wide credential
A strict sender-signature model, so the From address cannot drift silently
Domain and signature approval stay in your own Postmark account
considerations: Postmark reports failures inside a 200 response body, so the send is judged on that field rather than on the HTTP status alone.
